speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me determine the cause, please tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if you have experienced any recent fever, weight loss, or changes in your appetite.

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history; given your recent travel, hiking, and camping, have you noticed any specific insect bites, skin lesions, or signs of dehydration like dark urine or decreased thirst? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Electrolytes, Basic_Metabolic_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your blood work is currently normal, have you noticed any specific insect bites, skin lesions, or other unusual symptoms while hiking or camping recently? REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology_Scan, Vector_Exposure_Assessment

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text: The addition of mild diplopia (double vision) to your weakness and fatigue is a significant finding, particularly given your recent hiking trip. Have you also experienced difficulty swallowing, slurred speech, or shortness of breath? REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody, Anti-MuSK_Antibody, Creatine_Kinase.
